title: The AMPEL Platform: An Open-Source Project for Developing Hospital-Wide Clinical Decision Support Systems under EU-Regulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As incentives to digitize more and more aspects of medical healthcare are gaining traction, additional medical data is becoming available. A major goal is to use this data to gain further insights, support medical staff, and ultimately improve patient care. This demands sophisticated solutions that can handle current and future vast amounts of data, all without disrupting well-established workflows of care takers. Additionally, the solution must fulfill the documentation and risk-management obligations of the Medical Device Regulation (MDR), which governs whether a device may be used in patient care in Europe. In this context, we introduce the AMPEL platform, an open-source solution for creating clinical decision support systems (CDSS) that fulfil the requirements of the MDR. translated_title: AMPEL平台：一个在欧盟法规下开发全院级临床决策支持系统的开源项目
translated_abstract: 随着医疗保健领域数字化的激励措施日益受到关注，越来越多的医疗数据变得可用。一个主要目标是利用这些数据获得更深入的见解，支持医务人员，并最终改善患者护理。这需要复杂的解决方案，能够处理当前和未来的海量数据，同时不干扰医护人员既定的工作流程。此外，该解决方案必须履行医疗器械法规（MDR）规定的文档记录和风险管理义务，该法规决定了设备是否可以在欧洲用于患者护理。在此背景下，我们介绍了AMPEL平台，这是一个用于创建满足MDR要求的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）的开源解决方案。它以消息代理（Kafka）为中心，采用事件驱动的分布式架构，支持扩展和高效地处理医疗数据。
tldr: 本文介绍了开源的AMPEL平台，该平台采用以Kafka消息代理为中心的事件驱动分布式架构，用于开发符合欧盟医疗器械法规（MDR）要求的医院级临床决策支持系统。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the open-source AMPEL platform, which adopts an event-driven distributed architecture centered around the Kafka message broker, for developing hospital-wide clinical decision support systems that comply with the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) requirements.
